versions.content: Configuration of CanIf_GetTrcvWakeupReason() : The number of supported transceiver types for each network is set up in the configura- tion phase (see CanIfTrcvCfg and CanIfTrcvDrvCfg ). If no transceiver is used, this function may be omitted. Therefore, if no transceiver is configured in LT or PB class the API shall return with E_NOT_OK .
